annotator_pool.position_note: ``contested_position`` is an annotator's offset on the contested dimensions net of their leniency offset. It is a value position, not a quality defect: it does not count toward the flagged fraction and it is not remediable by retraining. ``systematic_bias`` is computed over the NON-contested dimensions only, so it measures leniency and nothing else.

composite_reliability.method: Krippendorff interval alpha of the per-annotator composite (unit=response), stepped up to the k-rater mean by Spearman-Brown.
composite_reliability.note: This -- not the mean of the per-dimension single-rater alphas -- is the reliability of the quantity the system comparisons are computed on, and it is what the power calculation consumes.

coverage.interpretation: 41/315 full-factorial cells are populated (87% empty), which is expected and not by itself a defect: full-factorial coverage grows multiplicatively and is not the operative target. The governing figure is marginal coverage: 17/18 declared strata levels reach n>=4 (6% short), with a worst-factor balance ratio of 0.06. Absent levels are excluded from every aggregate silently, so they are listed above.

decision.headline: Drop or rebuild the failing dimension(s) of 'reasoning'; keep the rest.
next_actions: Remove explanation_faithfulness from the reported composite immediately -- including them imports their noise into every downstream number.
Report the composite over answer_correctness, step_validity, premise_fidelity, verification_behavior only, and say so explicitly.
Decide separately whether explanation_faithfulness is worth rebuilding: if the judgement it encodes is genuinely contested, no anchor set will converge it.
Re-run agreement on the reduced composite before quoting any system delta.
rationale: Mean alpha across dimensions 0.559 (worst dimension 0.241); gold accuracy 77%.
95% CI half-width 0.076; MDE 0.127; largest observed between-system effect 0.050.
Reliability is not uniform: 4 dimension(s) reach usable agreement while 1 sit below 0.40 (explanation_faithfulness=0.24). This is a dimension-level defect, not a failure of the construct.
stop_criteria: Retire explanation_faithfulness permanently if a rebuilt version does not clear 0.50 on a 40-item bridge sample.

depth_contract: May report measurements with intervals and an explicit MDE. May report system deltas ONLY when the interval excludes zero and the delta exceeds the MDE. May not be used as a release gate.

drift.assumption: Valid only if item difficulty mix is constant across batches. Rubricon assigns responses to batches by serpentine difficulty-stratified dealing within each system; do not reuse this statistic on convenience-ordered batches.

known_limitations: explanation_faithfulness is not directly observable from output text. Annotators score textual symptoms of post-hoc rationalisation, which is a proxy for the construct, not the construct. We expect this dimension to show the lowest agreement and we will report it separately rather than pooling it into a headline alpha.

There is no chain-of-thought interpretability instrumentation behind this track. We observe only the emitted transcript, so we cannot distinguish a model that reasoned as described from one that reasoned otherwise and produced a plausible transcript.

Problems are short-form: three to six steps, single correct answer, solvable in under two minutes by a competent human. Findings do not transfer without re-piloting to long-horizon reasoning, multi-tool workflows, or open-ended proof.

English only, and the problem set draws on conventions of English-language school mathematics (notation, phrasing of word problems, decimal comma versus point). Trap types such as ambiguous_wording are language-specific by construction.

The reference answers are single canonical strings. Equivalent-form matching is left to annotator judgement rather than a normaliser, so answer_correctness carries a small amount of the very subjectivity it is supposed to be free of.

n = 44 items at replication 3 is a pilot-scale sample. Per-cell counts in the four-way stratification are one to three items, which supports reliability estimation and nothing more; no per-stratum system comparison from this track should be treated as powered.
name: Reasoning process quality

probes.interpretation: Within clean responses (quality approximately held constant), Spearman rho between length and composite is -0.248. Below tolerance; length does not appear to be driving the score.
Dimension 'answer_correctness' is matched 56% of the time by always answering 1 without reading the response. Below the 75% tolerance, so annotators are doing work a constant cannot do.

detail.corpus_caveat: Fixture responses are generated from a single latent quality factor, so inter-dimension correlation on this corpus partly reflects the generative model rather than the rubric.

probes.interpretation: 'premise_fidelity' alone correlates r=0.680 with the LEAVE-ONE-OUT composite (the composite recomputed with 'premise_fidelity' removed). The part-whole figure, against a composite that includes 'premise_fidelity' itself, is r=0.807; the gap between the two is arithmetic, not evidence, which is why the leave-one-out value is the one gated on. No single dimension reconstructs the rest of the composite, so the multi-dimensional structure is carrying real information. CORPUS CAVEAT: the responses in this repository are generated from a single latent quality factor per response, so the dimensions are correlated by construction. The inter-dimension correlations below therefore partly measure the generative fixture model, not the rubric. On real data this probe is diagnostic of rubric redundancy; here it is a demonstration that the probe runs and reports, and its magnitudes should not be read as a finding about rubric design.

detail.method: Sensitivity analysis, not a measurement. No pairwise judging was run; this solves for the artifact magnitude that would matter, measured as EXCESS flips above the noise floor rather than absolute flips.

probes.interpretation: Judgement noise alone (sigma=0.117) already reverses 23% of 132 pairwise comparisons. An order advantage of 0.157 composite points would add a further 10 percentage points of flips on top of that floor. The largest real between-system difference is 0.050, so an order artifact would have to exceed the real effect before it mattered. Counterbalancing is still cheap insurance.
Removing 'A6-untrained' moves the track mean by +0.0268, against a reported CI half-width of 0.0758. Single-annotator sensitivity sits inside the published interval.

redteam.verdict: Rubric shows no measured gameability on these probes.

research_question: Does scoring the reasoning process add signal beyond final-answer correctness, and can annotators apply process dimensions reliably? The headline case is 'right answer, wrong reasoning': a model that reaches the correct result through an invalid derivation is a latent failure that answer-only accuracy records as a success.

codes.description: off_by_one - an index, bound or count is out by one: an inclusive range read as exclusive, a term index shifted, a loop run once too often.
codes.diagnosis: Underpowered: only 1 planted instances (need >= 4). Sensitivity is not estimable; this is a sampling gap, not evidence the rubric misses the failure.

codes.description: sign_error - a sign is lost or flipped during distribution or transposition across the equals sign.
codes.diagnosis: Underpowered: only 2 planted instances (need >= 4). Sensitivity is not estimable; this is a sampling gap, not evidence the rubric misses the failure.

codes.description: circular_justification - the decisive step assumes the conclusion and then offers the conclusion's own consistency as evidence for it.
codes.diagnosis: Underpowered: only 2 planted instances (need >= 4). Sensitivity is not estimable; this is a sampling gap, not evidence the rubric misses the failure.

codes.description: case_analysis_incomplete - the problem requires a split into cases and at least one required case is never examined.
codes.diagnosis: Underpowered: only 3 planted instances (need >= 4). Sensitivity is not estimable; this is a sampling gap, not evidence the rubric misses the failure.

codes.description: unjustified_leap - the decisive inference is skipped: the text moves from setup to result with 'clearly' or 'it follows that' and no intervening argument.
codes.diagnosis: Underpowered: only 3 planted instances (need >= 4). Sensitivity is not estimable; this is a sampling gap, not evidence the rubric misses the failure.

codes.description: arithmetic_slip - a local computation is wrong (a product, sum or simplification) while the surrounding method is sound.
codes.diagnosis: Underpowered: only 2 planted instances (need >= 4). Sensitivity is not estimable; this is a sampling gap, not evidence the rubric misses the failure.

codes.description: invented_premise - the solution asserts a fact the problem never gave (replacement between draws, a midpoint meeting, a copied list).
codes.diagnosis: Underpowered: only 3 planted instances (need >= 4). Sensitivity is not estimable; this is a sampling gap, not evidence the rubric misses the failure.

codes.description: unit_error - the numbers are handled correctly but the units are not: a missing conversion factor, a squared factor applied once, a rate treated as a total.
codes.diagnosis: Underpowered: only 2 planted instances (need >= 4). Sensitivity is not estimable; this is a sampling gap, not evidence the rubric misses the failure.

codes.description: post_hoc_rationalization - the answer is produced first by recognition or recall, and the presented derivation is a narrative assembled around it rather than the reasoning that produced it.
codes.diagnosis: Underpowered: only 2 planted instances (need >= 4). Sensitivity is not estimable; this is a sampling gap, not evidence the rubric misses the failure.

codes.description: verification_theater - the solution claims to have checked its work but the claimed check contains no numbers, no substitution and no quantity that could have failed.
codes.diagnosis: Detected: responses carrying RF-11 score materially lower on 'verification_behavior' (Cliff's delta 0.88, large).

codes.description: right_answer_invalid_path - the final answer matches the reference but the derivation that reaches it is not valid: an invented rule, a coincidence, or two errors that cancel.

sensitivity.method_note: Cliff's delta compares mean-across-annotators scores on responses carrying the code against clean responses. Positive delta means the code depresses the score, i.e. the instrument registers it. Codes with fewer than 4 planted instances are reported as underpowered rather than undetected -- conflating those two would blame the rubric for a sampling gap.

post_adjudication_label_quality.label: label quality on the adjudicated subset
post_adjudication_label_quality.note: LABEL QUALITY, NOT RELIABILITY. Computed only on the adjudicated disagreement tail, against a final label derived from the same annotations. Not comparable to the pre-adjudication alpha reported as this track's reliability, and not to be quoted in its place.
